description:
Implement the core Anthropic Messages lane across the currently relevant Claude models we can support cleanly through the execution-plan architecture.

Scope:
- support representative Haiku, Sonnet, and Opus-style Anthropic models where the API shape is aligned
- keep the path execution-plan-first rather than model-name-branch-first
- ensure provider, semantic protocol, wire, transport, and policy decisions stay explicit
- add only the minimum edge-case overrides needed for real model differences

Focus:
- common Anthropic path should stay simple and metadata-driven
- model-specific quirks should be narrow and justified
title: Expand Anthropic Messages support across representative Claude models
